title: AVEVA RVM + interactive PBR effects panel
description: Loads an AVEVA RVM (plant-design) file through RVMLoader and exposes every renderer effect on top. Drop a .rvm at models/RVM_Sample/rvm/model.rvm and the example loads it directly; otherwise it synthesises a small plant skid (a base Box, four corner Cylinders, four valve-head Spheres) in-memory via the rvm module's ChunkWriter so the example always renders something.
